seal.statement: Scenario A latency and efficiency research has a valid substrate and honest records. A research profile class, dispatch family and subkind exist that admission refuses by one explicit reason and the record writer refuses to place in the published store. The runner accepts --profile research (one fresh deployment per run on the existing lifecycle; the dry run prints the frozen plan and that nothing is admissible; --storage-root and a passed semantic gate are required). Three Lagrange nodes run on one lab host on a campaign-scoped Docker bridge network (created and removed by the campaign's own deployment and cleanup owners, labelled with the campaign; a leftover network is a closure failure), declared truthfully: one host, the machine's real host name on every node, declared host count 1, standard ports on each node's own bridge address, the load generator on the same host, refused for every non-research plan. Every run records a substrate descriptor and a round-trip matrix (the load-generator-to-endpoint path and every ordered node pair, on the bridge for one host) measured before and after the window, never during it (seven entries for three nodes on either substrate: six ordered node pairs and the load generator to the endpoint). The dataset reset method is reported by the adapter that performed it. Every statement carries a monotonic start and end in a per-attempt timeline indexed into a per-run statement catalog. Retained statement evidence of every profile is brought into the campaign evidence beside the raw record, digest-verified, before the load-generator worktree is released, and a missing or mismatching file is a typed evidence failure. An unverified seed is never warmed up or measured. Every research plan and record names its substrate kind on a ladder (owner, 2026-11-28): lab-single-host (a first look; the report of such a run says so and no speed or efficiency claim stands on it), lab-multi-host (three separate lab hosts, one node each, load generator on a fourth machine that is not a product host; the working evidence, run repeatedly with its measured round trip recorded every time) and gcp-same-zone (final verification). Physical evidence: one completed research run on one lab host and one on three separate lab hosts; runs that did not complete because of the network are recorded and kept beside it and satisfy nothing.

text: Research profile class with admission and store barriers; substrate ladder (single-host bridge first look, three separate hosts as working evidence, same-zone cloud as final verification) with descriptor and round-trip matrix per run; adapter-reported reset method; per-statement timeline; custody of retained statement evidence; seed verification before warm-up; guard and witnesses; runbook text; the superseded predecessor's record files; generated inventories and shard metadata refreshed by the commit hook; the epic's quest list.
